checks.detail: the practitioner binds through the proxy as the restricted role
the removal waits on the membership row the admitted reply holds
the removal commits after the reply commits
the next reply, with the same already-issued identity, is refused
the reply waits on the row the uncommitted membership removal holds
after the membership removal commits, the reply is refused
no partial write: no reply stored
the reply waits on the row the uncommitted clinic suspension holds
after the clinic suspension commits, the reply is refused
no partial write: no reply stored
the sibling practitioner is refused at the binding
the same practitioner binds into their own clinic (the refusal is the clinic, not the person)
calling the setter directly is refused
an unrelated chart write is refused

limitations: A local disposable PostgreSQL cluster with fictional rows; not Aurora, the RDS Data API, a deployed Lambda or a hosted run.
The candidates are loaded into this throwaway cluster only; nothing is registered, applied or deployed, and no login is enabled.
Sessions assume the restricted login with SET SESSION AUTHORIZATION from a local superuser; no password or secret exists.
